reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper, which already handles missing, numeric and ranged amounts, instead of re-deriving the rule.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the field is a single call to the shared helper.

placement.why: The new field is computed in scheduleModel.toExternal, the layer that shapes schedules for the API.

scope.why: Only the API type and its toExternal mapping change; existing fields are untouched.

maintainability.why: A one-line derived field backed by the same helper the app uses, so it stays consistent with Actual's own rule.
